title: PocketBase API base URL: http://localhost:8090
body: The PocketBase instance runs at http://localhost:8090 on the Mac Mini. Key collection endpoints: /api/collections/tasks/records, /api/collections/heartbeats/records, /api/collections/comments/records, /api/collections/lessons/records, /api/collections/task_events/records. All filter strings must URL-encode special operators (see R18, R19).
source_ref: AGENTS/RULES.md heartbeat protocol; CLAUDE.md Phase 1/3; RUNTIME.md
